items.title: Elf Tying a Christmas Gift Bow
items.alt: Big-eyed cartoon elf in a green dress and floppy cap tying a red bow around a cream parcel.
items.description: The kneeling elf steadies a broad red ribbon above the cream gift box. Black braids, a red leaf collar and green-striped stockings give the small Christmas character a clear festive silhouette.

items.title: Elf Fitting a Toy Wagon Wheel
items.alt: Small green-overalled cartoon elf crouching beside a wooden wagon and fitting one wheel to its axle.
items.description: The elf holds a round wheel beside the little green wagon. A red pointed cap with a green band, short copper curls and curled red shoes frame the crouching pose.

items.title: Elf Sewing a Little Felt Fox
items.alt: Green-clothed cartoon elf seated on a gift box, sewing a small orange felt fox beside a basket of thread.
items.description: A little felt fox rests against the elf's green coat while one hand guides the thread. Cream hat trim, striped stockings and bright curled shoes surround the low gift-box seat.

items.title: Elf Carrying Star Cookies
items.alt: Curly-haired cartoon elf in a green tunic and cap holding a tray of three decorated star cookies.
items.description: Three iced stars sit on the elf's small gold-edged tray. Copper ringlets, bright violet eyes and a green zigzag hatband distinguish the cheerful standing character.

items.title: Elf with a Lantern and Firewood
items.alt: Smiling cartoon elf in a green outfit carrying a brass lantern and a small tied bundle of firewood.
items.description: The elf steps forward with a warm lantern held at one side and a small wood bundle at the other. A long dark braid, red sash and striped stockings add movement to the compact figure.

items.title: Elf Sitting on a Christmas Mail Sack
items.alt: Big-eyed cartoon elf in a green coat sitting on a mail sack and holding two sealed cream envelopes.
items.description: Two red-sealed envelopes rise above the elf's green coat. A floppy pom-pom cap, striped stockings and curled red shoes sit above the soft sack's holly and bell decorations.
